faq.answer: Selcuk is associated with the Turkish form سَلْجُوق, whose core sense is selcuk; seljuk (turkish tribal name).

faq.question: Is Selcuk an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Selcuk can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Turkish-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
